requiredFindings.title: New replay results revive withdrawn lower-bound labels and contradict their reset evidence
requiredFindings.evidence: The new cold replay result says LABELLED SYNTHETIC LOWER-BOUND GRAPHS and SM9LowerBoundOnly=true, and its resetLabel says no page-cache record and no Q0 cold label. The accepted replay round-2 review withdrew the real-workload bound; PLAN-r2 D-1 adopts a conditional synthetic convention. All60 current replay children have recorded cold resets and page-cache observations.
requiredFindings.impact: These are current generated result classifications, not merely unchanged historical comments. They can reintroduce the rejected bound in downstream use and misdescribe the reset actually measured, despite the correct top-level report and reset records.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Preserve the closed accepted runner and all measurement bytes. Correct the current replay interpretation in the new variant/result/derived record and report: use synthetic D-1 source-count scenarios, explicitly establish no real-workload bound, and label cold OpenSIP state with page cache recorded, never claimed flushed. If preserving the generated result verbatim, mark its inherited fields explicitly obsolete and supply a current corrected interpretation; retain the original as history. Do not rerun measurements or change replay inputs, algorithms, limits, timing boundaries or owned parameters.
